name: Arrangement
description: Shows the open Live Set's arrangement on the Push 3 screen, with zoom. Toggle with Shift+Session (uses MIDI intercept). Needs push-manager + push-display, and the PushHackArrangement Remote Script (installed with this hack) enabled once in Live.
author: federico-pepe
post_install: Select "PushHackArrangement" in a free control-surface slot (Input/Output = None) in Live's Preferences, then restart Live. Confirm "PushHackArrangement alive" in Live's Log.txt.
